submission.justification: Recommend Absorber-F2 with 5.35 mm plates. The project documents list Absorber-F2 as an allowed candidate and the 2025 5 mm study already showed it had the best 100 GeV resolution among the three materials (F2 3.2%, F3 3.9%, F1 5.1%). A new scan over 2-10 mm confirmed F2 is clearly superior to F1/F3, and a finer repeated scan in the F2 optimum region gave the best local performance near 5.35 mm; repeated 5.35 mm simulations averaged about 3.18% with a final check at 3.181%. The recommended thickness is inside the allowed range and no project document identifies an absorber-dependent maintenance incompatibility; support, cooling, and readout are documented as compatible/common across absorber choices.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Simulation scan: F2 outperformed the other candidates across the useful range. Coarse minima observed were approximately F1 ~4.96%, F3 ~3.87%, and F2 ~3.1-3.2%. Fine repeated F2 scans around the optimum selected 5.35 mm, with repeated runs averaging about 3.18% and a final run of 3.181% at 100 GeV.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Absorber-F2, Absorber-F3, and Absorber-F1. The recommendation uses Absorber-F2.

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: The project documents show no absorber-specific maintenance exclusion. The mechanical support design is compatible with every candidate absorber, the silicon-pad readout and front-end ASIC are common to all absorber options, cooling is common water cooling at 18 C, and all candidate absorbers can be machined to the required tolerances.
The recommended plate thickness is 5.35 mm, within the allowed 2-10 mm interval.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Absorber-F2 at 5.35 mm.
